# Technical-only route test uploads

Use a separate disposable synthetic Move or isolated route-assessment test. Do not mix these files into the member-service Move.

1. At P0/P1 record the request and adoption owner as provisional.
2. At P2 upload intake.md and adoption_boundary.csv; upload report_catalog.csv and data_pipeline_inventory.csv as uploaded_evidence.
3. Human-review extracted facts and explicitly validate no workflow change, no role change, reports_dashboards output, and business adoption responsibility.
4. Confirm the route becomes technical_product. Missing adoption owner, unsupported evidence reference, or unknown impact must remain unresolved.
